name: Subject pronouns
description: Understand and use Italian subject pronouns, including when the subject pronoun can naturally be omitted.

name: Noun gender
description: Recognise and use common masculine and feminine noun patterns.

name: Noun number
description: Recognise and form common singular and plural noun patterns.

name: Adjective gender agreement
description: Make common adjectives agree with masculine and feminine nouns.

name: Adjective number agreement
description: Make common adjectives agree with singular and plural nouns.

name: Definite articles
description: Choose and use the appropriate Italian definite article with common singular and plural nouns.

name: Indefinite articles
description: Choose and use the appropriate Italian indefinite article with common nouns.

name: Present tense: -are verbs
description: Conjugate and use common regular -are verbs in the present indicative.

name: Present tense: -ere verbs
description: Conjugate and use common regular -ere verbs in the present indicative.

name: Present tense: -ire verbs
description: Conjugate and use common regular -ire verbs in the present indicative.

name: Present tense: essere
description: Understand and use essere in the present indicative.

name: Present tense: avere
description: Understand and use avere in the present indicative.

name: Present tense: andare
description: Understand and use andare in the present indicative.

name: Present tense: fare
description: Understand and use fare in the present indicative.

errorRules.description: Uses an incorrect present-tense conjugation of fare for the required subject.
Uses the infinitive fare where a conjugated present-tense form is required.

name: Present tense: stare
description: Understand and use stare in the present indicative.

name: Potere + infinitive
description: Understand and use potere with an infinitive to express ability, possibility and simple requests.

name: Volere + infinitive
description: Understand and use volere with an infinitive to express wants and intentions.

name: Dovere + infinitive
description: Understand and use dovere with an infinitive to express basic needs and obligations.

name: Reflexive verbs
description: Understand and use common reflexive verbs to describe everyday routines.

name: Negation with non
description: Understand and form basic negative sentences using non.

name: Question formation
description: Understand and form basic questions in Italian.

name: Question words
description: Understand and use common Italian question words including chi, che, cosa, dove, quando, come, perché and quanto.

name: Possessives
description: Understand and use common Italian possessives with appropriate gender and number agreement.

name: Demonstratives
description: Understand and use common Italian demonstratives such as questo and quello.

name: C'è and ci sono
description: Understand and use c'è and ci sono to express the existence or presence of singular and plural things.

name: Piacere
description: Understand and use piacere to express basic likes and dislikes, including mi piace and mi piacciono.

name: Prepositions of place and movement
description: Understand and use common prepositions to express basic location, destination and movement.

name: Basic preposition use
description: Understand and use common basic prepositions including di, da, con, su and per in familiar A1 contexts.

name: Frequency expressions
description: Understand and use common expressions of frequency in familiar situations.

name: Quantity expressions
description: Understand and use common expressions of quantity in familiar situations.

name: Passato prossimo formation
description: Form the passato prossimo of common verbs using a present-tense auxiliary and past participle.

name: Passato prossimo auxiliary choice
description: Choose avere or essere as the auxiliary for common A1 verbs in the passato prossimo.
